command: uv run python scripts/c005_labels.py data/clean/hu2022_cm_allgenes_sanitized.h5ad markers results

label_file_format.cell: obs_names of the sanitised h5ad; one row per cell (32,044)
label_file_format.agent_state: border_zone_like | dedifferentiated | injury_responsive | proliferating | unassigned (ventricle-called cells) | not_scored (atrium-called or chamber-unassigned cells)
label_file_format.agent_states_all: semicolon-separated high axes; empty if none or not scored
label_file_format.agent_chamber: atrium | ventricle | unassigned; sourced rule B, see C004
label_file_format.score_<axis>: thinned score_genes within ventricle-called cells; NaN if not scored
